correctness.rationale: The 2007 established integral wedge theorem supplies free homology of rank C(n-1,2). The complete n=3 finite signed Lefschetz computation proves sign for both S3 actions. Column mergers are simplicial retractions: a matching on 3 target columns must lift to a matching on 3 distinct original columns. Off-diagonal composite maps have at most 2 target columns and vanish on H3. Integral retraction coordinates form a full basis, and for any three-column generator they agree exactly with the natural contraction (e_b-e_a) wedge (e_c-e_a); hence the integral S3 x Sn action is sign external tensor exterior square.
